newsitem.title: JAPAN: Further yen rise or fall undesirable - MITI minister.
newsitem.headline: Further yen rise or fall undesirable - MITI minister.

text.p: A further rise or fall of the yen against the dollar is undesirable, Minister of International Trade and Industry Shinji Sato said on Monday.

"Our position is that neither a further appreciation nor a depreciation of the yen is desirable," Sato said in a question and answer session after a speech at the Foreign Correspondents' Club of Japan.

He added that although the currency issue was not expected to top the agenda at the Group of Seven (G7) industrialsed nations' summit meeting from June 20-22, the issue was likely to be raised during bilateral talks with the United States.
"In such discussions, I intend to repeat that we see the current increase in the export figure is due in large part to seasonal factors and is a temporary phenomenon," he said.
"I intend to repeat our position that as long as economic structural reform is being steadily pursued and implemented there should be no problems," he said.
